```{r setup, include=FALSE}
valeur = function(x, defaut = "Non renseigne") {
  if (!length(x) || is.na(x[[1]]) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x[[1]]))))
    return(defaut)
  as.character(x[[1]])
}
# Les textes officiels sont du texte brut, pas du code Markdown/LaTeX.
# Echappement des caracteres interpretes par Pandoc et des antislashs.
texte = function(x) {
  x = valeur(x, "Texte non disponible dans la source officielle")
  x = gsub("\r\n?", "\n", x)
  x = gsub("\\\\par\\b", "\n", x, perl = TRUE)
  morceaux = strsplit(x, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  morceaux = trimws(morceaux)
  morceaux = morceaux[nzchar(morceaux)]
  # Echappement Markdown : aucune commande LaTeX de la source n'est executee.
  for (symbole in c("\\", "`", "*", "_", "{", "}", "[", "]", "<", ">", "#", "!", "|")) {
    morceaux = gsub(symbole, paste0("\\", symbole), morceaux, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  paste(morceaux, collapse = "\n\n")
}
```

```{r entete, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("\\gdef\\senateurstitre{", params$titre, "}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\gdef\\senateurssoustitre{", params$sous_titre, "}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\gdef\\senateurslogo{\\raisebox{-8pt}{\\includegraphics[height=0.78cm]{\\detokenize{",
    params$logo, "}}}}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\pagestyle{senateurs}\n")
```

```{r fiche, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
q = params$donnees$question[1, ]
cat("**Reference :** ", valeur(q$reference), "  \n",
    "**Date :** ", substr(valeur(q$datejodepot), 1, 10), "  \n",
    "**Senateur :** ", valeur(q$prenom), " ", valeur(q$nom), "\n\n",
    "## Question\n\n", texte(q$txtque), "\n\n", sep = "")
reponses = params$donnees$reponses
if (nrow(reponses)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(reponses))) {
    r = reponses[i, ]
    cat("## Reponse du ", substr(valeur(r$datejorep), 1, 10),
        "\n\n", texte(r$txtrep), "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
} else cat("## Reponse\n\nAucune reponse dans la base locale.\n")
```
